Message.Name: Order Update Market Sheet Message
Message.Description: The Order update message generated by the trading engine UTP indicates the creation or modification of a line in the "market sheet" (a.k.a

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: UTP-MD proprietary identification of the instrument

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: This field specifies the time when the Order Update is generated

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: This field specifies the sequence number assigned by the source system to this message

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price (Tto be calculated with the PriceScaleCode

Field.Name: AggregatedVolume
Field.Description: Total quantity of orders at the given price level BondSpot: Not applicable

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: Displayed quantity of the order

Field.Name: LinkID
Field.Description: Not used

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Identifies the uniqueness of the order, when combined with OrderDate

Field.Name: SystemID
Field.Description: The ID of the originating Exchange/System of the message

Field.Name: SourceTimeMicroSecs
Field.Description: Number of micro seconds

Field.Name: NumberOrders
Field.Description: Number of orders in the Book at the price of the current order BondSpot: Not applicable

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Indicates the side of the order

Field.Name: OrderType
Field.Description: Type of Order

Field.Name: ActionType
Field.Description: This field identifies the type of operation on order book

Field.Name: PriceScaleCode
Field.Description: Applicable to all prices in the message

Field.Name: OrderDate
Field.Description: Date of order (YYYYMMDD)

Field.Name: OrderPriorityDate
Field.Description: Date giving the priority of the order (YYYYMMDD)

Field.Name: OrderPriorityTime
Field.Description: Time giving the priority of the order (HHMMSSsss)

Field.Name: OrderPriorityMicroSecs
Field.Description: Number of micro seconds in the current millisecond BondSpot: Set to zero

Field.Name: OrderOrigin
Field.Description: Not used

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: For future use
